item.title: Kansas City Winter Resources for the Unhoused: What to Do and Where to Go When Temperatures Drop
item.description: As winter settles in, hundreds of Kansas Citians are facing the cold without shelter. This guide pulls together shelter, food, medical, and warming resources so people living outside, families navigating homelessness, and those looking to help know where to turn. item.title: Kansas City at Center of ICE Nationwide Concentration Camp Network
item.description: ICE is eyeing to make Kansas City one of seven "mega centers" in its unprecedented concentration camp network. item.title: SHUT IT DOWN, GET ICE OUT! Nationwide General Strike January 30th
item.description: Following Minnesota's massively successful general strike, unions across the nation are calling for a nationwide general strike this Friday, January 30th.
